title: Step 1 proof: our shape modelled as real glass in Blender and rendered in Cycles (generated cover), beside the main reference, same framing
notes: part: The cover sits on the ridge and looks heavy: set deep in a thick ring of glass, the ridge rolling under its lower edge; the ring reads thinner and darker than the reference.
part: The ridge is one unbroken line from under the cover to the tail: one roll all the way, under the words, up the twist, along the sheet, into the tail; its highlight breaks in places.
ok: The twist and the sheet over the buttons read clearly: the sheet hangs over the wells as real glass.
part: The words are clean: crisp on top, but a reflection line wraps the end of the title and the artist.
part: The glass shines: real refraction and highlights along every roll, but darker and less luminous than the reference.
